knowledge.markdown:
# Knowledge Base: Poincaré Conjecture

## The Problem

The Poincaré Conjecture: Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is homeomorphic to S³.

**SOLVED** by Grigori Perelman in 2002-2003 using Ricci flow with surgery.

## Formalization Status

### PoincareConjecture.lean (459 lines, 0 sorries, 12 axioms)

**Docker build verified: 2026-02-11**

| Result | Status |
|--------|--------|
| S³ properties | PROVED |
| n-sphere properties | PROVED |
| Simply connected bridge | PROVED (Mathlib) |
| FundamentalGroup triviality | PROVED |
| Thurston 8 geometries | PROVED (native_decide) |
| Main theorem (dim 3) | DERIVED from axioms |
| Generalized (all dim ≥ 2) | PROVED |

### 12 Deep Axioms

RicciCurvature, RiemannianMetric, RicciFlow (type defs), perelman_surgery, perelman_finite_extinction, thurston_geometrization, PerelmanWEntropy, perelman_entropy_monotone, hamilton_positive_ricci, generalized_poincare_high_dim, poincare_dim_4, poincare_dim_2.

None of these can be reduced with current Mathlib.

## References

- Perelman (2002-2003): Three arXiv papers on Ricci flow with surgery
- Hamilton (1982): Ricci flow introduction
- Smale (1961): h-cobordism theorem
- Freedman (1982): Topological 4-manifolds
